_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: AUD-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

title.description: Title of the audit; used as its display value in other collections

standard.description: Standard or specification the record refers to

areaName.description: Display value of areaId, copied from u_mes_mdm_area.name

lineName.description: Display value of lineId, copied from u_mes_mdm_line.name

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mdm_customer.name

layer.description: Audit layer (1 = line leader, 2 = supervisor, 3 = manager)

leadAuditorUserId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: lead auditor user

leadAuditorUserName.description: Display value of leadAuditorUserId, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

auditeeUserName.description: Display value of auditeeUserId, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

plannedDate.description: Planned date (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

startedAt.description: Date and time when the record was started

completedAt.description: Date and time when the record was completed

checkSheetName.description: Display value of checkSheetId, copied from u_mes_qlt_checkSheet.name

reportControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_sys_controlledDocument._id: report controlled document

reportControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of reportControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_sys_controlledDocument.title

nextAuditDueAt.description: Next audit due date and time

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName
